NOTE
**Still not ready: screenshots are only in a comment, with no before/after comparison**

New: The author posted two screenshots (one desktop-width, one mobile-width) in a comment and said the description was updated. There is no new push. Missing: the description still says "Screenshots to be added by author in comments", and there are no before/after screenshots at different sizes, which issue #40051 explicitly asks for.

###### Next step

"Not ready" stays and no one needs to be assigned. If the author does fix this, check first how it compares with the open #40052, which touches the same file for the same issue.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding screenshots! Please put them in the PR description itself (replacing the placeholder), and show clear before/after shots at a few different widths, as described in [our guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html). Please also finish the unchecked items in the self-review checklist.
```
